codes.label: Auto Color Enhance
codes.description: Automatic contrast, white balance, saturation, and warmth correction using per-frame average color stats. Fully adjustable blend strength.

codes.label: Vision Clarity
codes.description: A lightweight GLSL video filter that reduces motion blur and enhances clarity while preserving natural textures. Features adjustable FSR, RCAS, and ECAS controls for balanced, artifact-free sharpening optimized for video content.

codes.label: Bilateral Denoise + CAS Sharpen
codes.description: 3×3 bilateral filter for edge-preserving denoising followed by Contrast-Adaptive Sharpening (CAS). Cleans noise while restoring lost clarity.
